summary: Tested FANCHI AI Car Wrap Visualizer backend (18 pytest tests across catalog, generate-wrap validation, auth, wraps, auto-save) and frontend E2E (anonymous upload->consent->product->generate gating, catalog search/filter, error state, authenticated header + My Wraps + logout). 14/18 backend tests pass. All 4 failures are the real Gemini image generation calls, which now return 503 because the Emergent Universal Key budget is exhausted ('Budget has been exceeded! Key=dachre2n9pgc738rtlj0 Current cost: 0.479, Max budget: 0.4'). App code path is correct and degrades gracefully; generation itself could not be verified end-to-end in this environment.

critical.issue: Returns 503 {code:busy} for every request. Backend log root cause: litellm.RateLimitError - 'Budget has been exceeded! Key=dachre2n9pgc738rtlj0 (sk-...AVMQ) Current cost: 0.479, Max budget: 0.4'. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhausted, so real Gemini image generation (and therefore auto-save + Before/After UI) cannot be verified. Needs a budget top-up / new key - NOT a code defect.

minor.issue: Budget-exceeded is mapped to the 'busy' message via the substring match on 'rate' in the exception text. Functionally acceptable, but a permanently exhausted key shows 'try again in a moment' forever. Consider a distinct quota/config message.

image_base64 is not validated (no base64/size/mime check). Empty string or garbage base64 reaches the LLM and comes back as a 500/503 instead of a fast 400. Structured error shape is correct, but add Pydantic-level validation.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed end-to-end because backend returns 503 (LLM budget). UI correctly renders error-state-busy-container with exact message 'FANCHI AI is currently busy. Please try again in a moment.' + RETRY NOW button. Before/After slider, TRY ANOTHER COLOR and DOWNLOAD could NOT be exercised (no image available).

issues: Avatar image src for the seeded test user (via.placeholder.com) fails to load and renders a broken-image glyph next to the name. Seed-data artifact, but consider an onError fallback (initials) on data-testid=user-avatar.

action_items: Top up / replace EMERGENT_LLM_KEY - budget exceeded (max 0.4 reached) blocks all /api/generate-wrap calls; then re-test generation, auto-save, Before/After, TRY ANOTHER COLOR and DOWNLOAD.
Optional: distinct error message/code for quota-exhausted vs transient busy.
Optional: validate image_base64 (decodable, size limit, image mime) and return 400 fast.
Optional: onError fallback for user avatar image.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user is duplicated logically in auth_logout (token extraction repeated) - extract a helper _extract_token(request).

Wraps are stored as full base64 data URIs in MongoDB; GET /api/wraps returns up to 24 docs with both original_image and wrapped_image, which can easily exceed several MB per response. Consider a list endpoint returning metadata + thumbnails and a separate detail endpoint.
generate-wrap has no timeout guard around the LlmChat call; a hung Gemini request will hold the worker indefinitely.
requests.get (blocking) is used inside the async /api/auth/session handler - blocks the event loop; use httpx.AsyncClient.

rca_of_the_issue: All /api/generate-wrap calls fail with HTTP 503 {code:'busy'}. Backend log (/var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log) shows litellm.RateLimitError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Key=dachre2n9pgc738rtlj0 (sk-...AVMQ) Current cost: 0.4790744999999999, Max budget: 0.4'. The Emergent Universal Key's spend cap is reached, so Gemini image editing is rejected upstream. server.py's except-branch matches 'rate' in the message and returns the 503 busy error, which the frontend renders correctly. Reproduction: POST /api/generate-wrap with any valid base64 car image + catalog product -> 503 within ~2s (no 20-90s latency, confirming the request never reaches the model). Mitigation: increase/reset the LLM key budget or supply a new EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, then re-run TestGenerateWrapReal and TestAutoSave.
